name: prediction_scorecard
event: Agni-4 MRBM test, 06 August 2026, ITR Chandipur (Strategic Forces Command)

ground_truth.outcome: successful; all operational and technical parameters validated

calls.claim: A strategic trial is scheduled for 6-7 August
calls.basis: 819/26 parsed: EXPERIMENTAL FLIGHT TRIALS 06 AND 07 AUG 1230-1530 UTC
calls.outcome: CORRECT — fired 6 August, the first declared day

calls.claim: Launch falls in the 1230-1530 UTC window
calls.outcome: CONSISTENT — MoD announced at 13:24 UTC, inside the window. The announcement time is not the launch time, so this is corroboration, not proof.
CORRECT — Agni-4 is in the candidate set. The geometry narrowed 27 systems to 6 and the right one was among them; it did not identify which, and never claimed to.

calls.claim: 6 August was the least favourable day (99% cloud, 0/24 favourable hours); if it slipped it would slip to the 7th
calls.outcome: WRONG, and instructively so. It fired under 100% cloud on a day with 24.3 mm of rain. But inside the declared 1230-1530Z window the weather was the calmest, driest part of that day: 0.0 mm rain and 3.3-3.9 m/s gusts at 12-13Z, with 12.9-15.0 km horizontal visibility. The heuristic failed because cloud cover dominated it at an 80% threshold, and cloud is the wrong variable — it gates optical tracking, which a Strategic Forces Command user trial of a proven system does not depend on. Wind and rain, the actual physical constraints, were benign exactly when it mattered.
WRONG — actual system was Agni-4, the third-least mentioned. Volume of speculation was inversely related to accuracy.

calls.claim: A launch would show as a thermal anomaly over the pads
calls.outcome: NOT DEMONSTRATED. FIRMS returned ZERO detections over both the pad and range boxes across a 3-day window spanning the launch. A ballistic launch plume lasts seconds; VIIRS/MODIS revisit is twice daily and was looking through 100% cloud. The indicator cannot see an event of this kind and its 0.05 quiet floor was, in hindsight, the only honest reading it could have given.

calls.claim: The declared warnings would cancel once the trial completed
calls.basis: 819/26 carries CANCEL THIS MSG 071630 UTC AUG 26
calls.outcome: NOT YET. Both 818/26 and 819/26 remain in force with 2 windows each as of 07 Aug 06:14 UTC. The second declared window (1230-1530Z today) still stands, so the range has not stood down. 7 of the 34 archived messages have gone and 6 new ones appeared.

social_reversal.reading: Agni-IV went from 3 mentions to 58; Agni-V and Agni-VI collapsed from 50 combined to 8. The pre-event corpus was confidently and uniformly wrong, and its confidence was proportional to its wrongness. Geometry narrowed 27 systems to 6 and the right answer was inside that set; speculation named the two systems it was not.

data.headline: The schedule was called correctly and the candidate set contained the answer. Every attempt to go further — which day within the window, which system, whether sensors would see it — was either wrong or unsupported.

not_scored.gnss_interference: Dropped from the scorecard. A 35-day baseline shows 37% of days carry at least one degraded-accuracy aircraft in the AOI, so launch day's 3 is unremarkable and the feed cannot distinguish signal from background here.
